def reduce(instance):
    num_vars = instance["num_vars"]
    clauses = instance["clauses"]

    edges = []
    def add_edge(u, v):
        edges.append([u, v])

    # Base triangle: 0 = B, 1 = T, 2 = F
    B, T, F = 0, 1, 2
    add_edge(B, T)
    add_edge(B, F)
    add_edge(T, F)

    next_id = 3
    # forced-false node: adjacent to B and T -> must be F
    false_node = next_id; next_id += 1
    add_edge(false_node, B)
    add_edge(false_node, T)

    # variable gadgets
    pos = {}
    neg = {}
    for v in range(1, num_vars + 1):
        p = next_id; next_id += 1
        n = next_id; next_id += 1
        pos[v] = p
        neg[v] = n
        add_edge(p, n)
        add_edge(p, B)
        add_edge(n, B)

    def lit_node(lit):
        if lit > 0:
            return pos[lit]
        else:
            return neg[-lit]

    for clause in clauses:
        l1, l2, l3 = clause
        # fresh y variable
        yp = next_id; next_id += 1
        yn = next_id; next_id += 1
        add_edge(yp, yn)
        add_edge(yp, B)
        add_edge(yn, B)
        # NAE gadget 1: (l1, l2, yp)
        a1 = next_id; next_id += 1
        b1 = next_id; next_id += 1
        c1 = next_id; next_id += 1
        add_edge(a1, b1); add_edge(a1, c1); add_edge(b1, c1)
        add_edge(a1, lit_node(l1))
        add_edge(b1, lit_node(l2))

        c2 = next_id; next_id += 1

        add_edge(a2, yn)
        add_edge(b2, lit_node(l3))
        add_edge(c2, false_node)

    return {"n": next_id, "edges": edges}
